new_jobs.title: Operations Manager
new_jobs.jd: Our client is a fast-growing consumer goods brand with operations across the region - known for premium, high quality products and a high growth model. They're looking for a hands-on Operations Manager to be based in Taipei - owning day-to-day 3PL and logistics execution, supporting demand planning with local market insights, and acting as the key link between the Taiwan and the regional supply chain team. You will serve as the go-to person for all things logistics related in Taiwan and work collaboratively with the team to ensure smooth day to day operations of the business. This is a great opportunity for someone to take real ownership of a market's operational backbone, room to grow as the business scales and to work in a vibrant and high trust work culture. * ~3 years' experience in operations, logistics, supply chain * Experience with 3PL coordination will be important * Strategic thinker with autonomous working style * Hands on and grounded, with great interpersonal skills. * Strong English and Mandarin proficiency

new_jobs.jd: * \* 加入全球知名家電品牌，直接影響全台售後服務策略與營運成果 * \* 領導自有工程師與服務夥伴網絡，打造卓越客戶體驗 **About Our Client** 我們的客戶為全球知名消費型家電品牌，長期以創新產品、高品質服務及卓越客戶體驗聞名。隨著業務持續成長，公司積極投入售後服務體系升級，致力於透過數位化管理、服務網絡優化及人才發展，提供市場領先的客戶服務體驗。 **Job Description** * 負責管理全台自有維修工程師團隊，包括派工規劃、產能配置、績效管理及服務品質提升。 * 建立並管理全台維修服務夥伴網絡，涵蓋廠商遴選、合約管理、KPI監控及品質稽核。 * 分析維修、故障及客訴數據，找出根本原因並推動服務流程與作業效率改善。 * 與客服、技術支援、品質管理、物流及備件團隊密切合作，優化售後服務流程與客戶體驗。 * 管理維修成本、服務預算及營運績效報告，並向高階主管提出改善建議與策略規劃。 **The Successful Applicant** * 具8年以上售後服務、維修營運、現場服務或服務網絡管理相關經驗。 * 具3年以上團隊管理、授權服務中心、維修商或外部服務夥伴管理經驗。 * 熟悉以數據管理維修時效、重修率、服務品質、零件使用及營運成本。 * 具合約管理、報價審核、請款管理及跨部門協調經驗。 * 具家電、消費性電子產品或多據點現場服務營運經驗者尤佳。 **What's on Offer** * 在全球領導品牌中主導全台售後服務營運專案。 * 與區域及跨功能團隊合作，拓展策略管理與營運領導影響力。 * 外商知名品牌、發展性良好。 **Quote job ref: JN-112026-7152043**

new_jobs.title: AI Solution Project Manager - Manufacturing Digital Transformation
new_jobs.jd: **職位名稱：** AI 專案經理 / AI 導入專案經理 (智慧製造 / Digital Twin / AI Agent) **上班地點：** 台北市內湖區新湖一路 398 號（需支援桃園龜山廠區，並配合海外廠區出差，年累積約 3 個月以下） **職務說明** Cooler Master 正加速從硬體製造向 AI 智慧製造與數位孿生轉型。這個角色不是單純追蹤進度的傳統 IT PM，而是負責將 **AI Agent、Digital Twin（數位孿生）與 Physical AI** 從概念驗證（PoC）真正推進到工廠產線與營運現場的關鍵推手。你將直接面對製造現場的真實挑戰，在有限資源下定義優先順序，帶領跨部門團隊完成從 0 到 1 的 AI 落地。 **工作內容** 1. **End-to-End AI 專案落地** ：主導智慧製造、數位孿生、Physical AI 及內部 AI Agent 專案，涵蓋需求定義、PoC 驗證、系統整合到產線及營運單位正式上線（Production）。 2. **多項 PoC 並行與資源動態調度** ：同時推進多項 AI PoC 專案，建立明確的驗證指標（Success Criteria）與退場機制；在算力（如地端 GPU 資源有限）與開發人力受限的情況下，精準評估 ROI 並排定優先順序。 3. **從 0 到 1 的流程梳理與架構定義** ：深入內湖總部、桃園龜山及海外廠區，面對尚未標準化（SOP 不明）的作業流程，協助營運與製造單位釐清真實痛點，將模糊需求轉化為可執行的 AI 解決方案。 4. **高階向上管理與跨部門協作** ：具備優秀的向上管理（Upward Management）能力，能精準向管理層彙報專案價值、技術邊界與風險；作為 IT、AI 技術團隊與工廠端（OT）之間的橋樑，化解跨單位認知落差。 5. **風險控管與務實交付** ：結合敏捷（Agile）與傳統專案管理思維，預判資料品質不足、現場導入阻力等風險，提出務實的替代方案（Workaround），確保專案如期交付。 **條件要求** * **年資與產業背景** ： **5** 年以上工作經驗，具備 **3** 年以上大型系統、智慧製造或企業級 AI 專案管理實務經驗（ **具電子製造業、ODM/EMS 工廠端導入經驗者優先** ）。 * **AI 專案實戰力** ：具備多項 PoC 同步管理經驗，且至少有 1 至 2 個 AI 專案（如 LLM/AI Agent、Digital Twin、CV 瑕疵檢測、預測性維護等）成功走完 End-to-End 並實際上線的實績。 * **高度耐受不確定性（Ambiguity Tolerance）** ：熟悉製造業現場生態，能在制度與 SOP 尚未完善、地端算力與預算有限的條件下，依然能主動拆解問題、找到路徑推進專案，而非等待完美條件才動工。 * **技術理解與務實思維** ：熟悉 SDLC 開發流程，具備足夠的 AI 與軟硬體基礎認知（了解模型推論限制、地端與雲端算力差異），能與工程師對焦技術可行性，並適時管理業務單位的期待與專案範圍（Scope）。 * **溝通與出差配合度** ：具備極佳的結構化簡報、向上呈報與跨部門談判能力；英文具備中等以上溝通能力（可進行跨國會議與文件撰寫），可配合至桃園龜山廠區及海外廠區出差（年累積 3 個月以下）。 **Job Title:** AI Project Manager (Smart Manufacturing, Digital Twin & AI Agents) **Location:** Neihu District, Taipei (with regular support at Guishan Plant, Taoyuan, and international plant travel; total travel time is less than 3 months/year) **About the Role** Cooler Master is accelerating its transformation into an AI-driven smart manufacturing enterprise. This is not a traditional IT maintenance role—you will be the driving force turning **AI Agents, Digital Twins, and Physical AI** from early concepts into production-ready solutions on the factory floor and across global operations. You will operate in a fast-paced, 0-to-1 environment, navigating real-world manufacturing constraints to deliver measurable business impact. **Key Responsibilities** * **End-to-End AI Delivery:** Lead AI Smart Manufacturing, Digital Twin, Physical AI, and internal AI Agent initiatives from problem framing and PoC through system integration and full production deployment. * **Multi-PoC Portfolio Management:** Manage multiple concurrent PoCs with clear success metrics and go/no-go gates. Prioritize high-ROI use cases under real-world constraints, such as limited on-premises compute capacity and engineering bandwidth. * **0-to-1 Process & Requirement Discovery:** Partner with stakeholders across Neihu HQ, Guishan, and overseas plants to untangle ambiguous workflows where SOPs are still evolving, translating operational bottlenecks into actionable AI specifications. * **Upward Management & Cross-Functional Alignment:** Deliver clear, executive-level reporting on project milestones, technical boundaries, and ROI. Bridge communication gaps between OT (factory operations), IT, and AI engineering teams. * **Pragmatic Risk Mitigation:** Blend Agile and structured PM methodologies to anticipate bottlenecks—such as fragmented data or shop-floor adoption resistance—and execute practical workarounds to keep deployments on track. **Qualifications** * **Experience:** 5+ years of overall experience, including 3+ years managing complex enterprise systems, smart manufacturing, or AI implementation projects ( **electronics manufacturing, ODM, or EMS background strongly preferred** ). * **Proven AI Track Record:** Hands-on experience running multiple PoCs in parallel, with a demonstrated track record of taking at least one AI initiative (e.g., LLM/AI Agents, Digital Twin, Computer Vision, or Predictive Maintenance) end-to-end into live production. * **Resourcefulness in Ambiguous Environments:** Comfortable operating without rigid SOPs. Proven ability to stay pragmatic and drive momentum despite limited on-premises AI compute, evolving infrastructure, or shifting priorities. * **Technical Fluency & Scope Discipline:** Solid grasp of SDLC and practical AI fundamentals (understanding inference/compute trade-offs and data readiness) to challenge engineering estimates and manage stakeholder scope effectively. * **Communication & Mobility:** Strong executive presence, presentation, and negotiation skills. Intermediate-or-above English proficiency for cross-border collaboration; able to support the Guishan plant and travel to overseas manufacturing sites (less than 3 months/year).

new_jobs.title: [ IC設計公司 ] Digital Design Engineer轉AI Engineer(新竹/2年以上IC設計經驗)
new_jobs.jd: A leading IC design company in Taiwan seeks an LLM Application Engineer to develop advanced AI applications, driving next-generation intelligent systems. 需求條件： 1. Physical Deisgn / EDA Exp. 2-7 years **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and deploy production-grade LLM applications, RAG systems, and AI agent architectures that deliver scalable, business-critical AI solutions * Build and optimise high-performance backend services and APIs using Python, FastAPI, and Linux, ensuring reliability, security, and seamless data integration * Engineer end-to-end data pipelines by processing structured and unstructured data and implementing semantic search with vector embeddings using MongoDB or Elasticsearch * Develop intelligent AI agents leveraging advanced LLM capabilities, including function calling and reasoning workflows, to enable automation and informed decision-making * Partner with cross-functional teams to align AI solutions with business objectives while documenting best practices to support knowledge sharing, maintainability, and continuous improvement **Candidate Profile** * Proven experience deploying production-grade AI and LLM applications, delivering reliable, scalable solutions in real-world environments * Advanced proficiency in Python, FastAPI, OpenAI SDK, and prompt engineering, with expertise in function calling, memory management, and LLM application development * Hands-on experience with Linux environments, NoSQL databases (MongoDB or Elasticsearch), semantic search, vector embeddings, and backend infrastructure * Strong capability in processing structured and unstructured data (JSON, SQL, CSV, PDFs, HTML, raw text) to support AI, RAG, and semantic search applications * Excellent communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into effective business solutions **About The Company** A leading IC design company in Taiwan is recognised for its innovation in semiconductor technologies and investment in AI-driven engineering solutions. It offers a collaborative and flexible work environment with strong support for learning, professional growth, and long-term career development. **Keywords:** LLM application engineer, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), python & fastapi, AI agent development **What’s Next** Shape the future of AI by building intelligent LLM solutions that power real-world innovation. Apply now!

new_jobs.title: AI應用軟體技術經理 Lead SW Engineer (AI Application)
new_jobs.jd: **Purpose of this Position** 以AI技術驅動內部營運流程優化與跨部門系統整合，提升組織效率與決策品質；同時支援產品開發端導入AI應用，將AI價值延伸至Moxa工業網通產品，強化組織競爭力 工作比重：內部營運優化與系統整合 約70%｜產品開發端AI應用 約30% **Major Areas of Responsibility** * 內部營運: 盤點營運流程與場域需求，釐清問題定義、資料需求與成功標準，設計並導入AI解決方案（LLM應用、Agentic Workflow、MCP工具整合），串接跨部門系統與資料，提升營運效 * 內部營運: 主導跨部門AI專案，從需求探索、PoC到上線維運全程負責，掌握範疇、里程碑、風險與資源配置；建置團隊共用AI平台，設計可重用、可維護的元件 * 產品開發: 與產品開發團隊合作，評估AI於產品功能與研發流程的應用機會，實作PoC並驗證可行性，推動導入與交接 * 共通: 產出交付上線後的監控、維運、成本管理，以及使用率和成效追蹤；建立LLM功能評估方法（測試集、驗收標準、LLM-as-a-judge），撰寫技術報告、架構說明與決策紀錄供決策參考，並推動AI技術分享與內部培訓，發展學習型組織 **Minimum Job Requirements** * 資訊工程、電腦科學或相關領域碩士以上學歷，具備5年以上軟體開發或AI/ML實務經驗，其中至少2年LLM/AI應用開發經驗 * 熟悉Python與LLM API開發，具備Agentic系統、RAG、MCP或Tool Use實作經驗；具企業內部系統整合或流程自動化經驗者佳 * 具備系統整合與部署經驗： RESTful API application、DevOps (Docker/CI/CD)、LLM Trace Tool (Langfuse, ...) * 至少有 1 個 AI 應用正式上線並持續維運的實績 * 具備良好的溝通能力與專案執行力，能將模糊需求轉化為可交付成果，並與技術及非技術對象有效溝通 **Required Competencies** * 技術專業與問題解決：能分析並應用AI技術解決營運與產品的實際問題，並以可驗證的方式評估成果 * 系統整合與架構思維：能串接跨系統資料與流程，設計可重用、可維護的AI解決方案 * 協作與影響力：能整合跨部門資源，推動共識並完成任務 * 知識傳遞：能將技術經驗轉化為文件與組織能力，促進團隊成長

new_jobs.title: Manager, Business Solutions Engineering
new_jobs.jd: Yahoo Taiwan E-Commerce empowers the e-commerce world with advanced business process analytics, reporting, and optimization tools designed to drive success within Yahoo Taiwan E-commerce ecosystem. Innovation is at the core of everything we do — we continuously test, refine, and integrate cutting-edge technologies to stay ahead of the curve and enhance our infrastructure. Our team is dedicated to creating high-quality products and tools that not only prioritize usability and efficiency but also foster sustainable business growth for our customers and partners. **Responsibilities** * 解決方案規劃與技術窗口：參與業務提案與洽談，主導技術溝通與決策，將業務需求轉化為完整的系統架構、規格、時程與成本評估。 * 系統建置與跨BU 平台串接：負責系統從設計到上線的全程建置，主導跨部門供銷平台（商品、庫存、訂單、金物流與對帳等）的標準化與模組化串接，並確保系統穩定與資安。 * 團隊組建與資源整合：依項目需求彈性調度內部人力與資源，負責團隊培養、流程建立與廠商管理，並與技術團隊協調分工及資源配置，推動落實專案。 * 系統承接與持續運維：承接並盤點既有電商系統，建立文件與問題追蹤機制，持續推動功能優化、版本迭代並支援業務營運。 * AI 工具導入與業務賦能：評估並導入AI 工具，支援業務提案、研究分析、文案及報表自動化，透過培訓及使用指引提升應用成效，並增進開發、測試及文件作業效率，確保符合公司與集團的資安及資料治理規範。 **Qualifications** * 大學以上學歷，資訊工程、資訊管理、電子商務或相關科系尤佳。 * 10 年以上電商產業經驗尤佳。 * 5 年以上技術團隊管理經驗，曾帶領團隊從零到一完成系統建立並上線。 * 具備解決方案架構規劃能力，能依業務需求提出技術方案並評估可行性、成本與風險。 * 具備跨系統、跨組織平台串接的實際經驗，熟悉API 設計、系統整合架構及資料交換機制。 * 具備AI 工具（如生成式AI、AI 助理、自動化工具等）的實務使用經驗，並能分享具體應用成果。 * 優異的溝通與轉譯能力，能在業務、技術與高階管理層之間有效溝通並推動決策。

new_jobs.title: AI Solution Architect
new_jobs.jd: **Join Trend ‧ Join New Generation** **趨勢科技 - 全球雲端資安領航者 / 全亞洲最大軟體公司 / 企業版圖橫跨五大洲 / 趨勢全球研發基地在台灣** =============================================================== **About This Role** We are looking for an experienced AI Solution Architect to advance the application of AI technologies across Trend Micro's security products. Leverage expertise in AI/ML and system architecture to address complex technical challenges, design scalable solutions, and enhance security detection capabilities. You will assess technical challenges, identify suitable technologies and architectural approaches, and translate them into practical solutions that can support large-scale data processing, high traffic volumes, and complex product environments. Drive technical exploration, validate proposed solutions, and guide their implementation from initial concepts to production-scale adoption. You will also play an important role in influencing technical decisions and aligning architecture directions across teams. **Core Responsibilities** **AI Architecture & Technical Strategy** * Define and drive AI architecture strategies and technical direction across security products. * Analyze complex technical challenges and design scalable AI/ML-based solutions to improve product capabilities new_jobs.title: Senior Digital Twin Engineer - (3D/Omniverse/Computer Vision))
new_jobs.jd: **【 About the Role 】** 在 Cooler Master，我們正在重新定義軟硬體整合與智慧製造的未來！作為資深數位孿生工程師，你將站在 NVIDIA Omniverse 平台與 Physical AI（物理 AI）的最前線，將前沿的 3D 視覺化技術、LLM Agent 與具身智能（Robotics / Isaac Sim）深度融合。你將與頂尖的跨領域團隊並肩作戰，構建從物理世界到虛擬場景、從高真度模擬到 AI 決策的完整工業數位孿生生態系。 **【Why Join Us? 】** * **前沿技術落地：** 全面導入 NVIDIA Omniverse、USD 核心架構與 Isaac Sim，打造次世代 AI 智慧工廠，並實現研發/生產自動化模擬。 * **資產數位化、Physical AI & 合成資料應用：** 透過 2D/3D 合成資料生成（Synthetic Data Generation）與機器人模擬，解決真實世界數據稀缺問題，推動生成式 AI 與具身智能真實落地。 * **跨領域技術樞紐：** 連結工業設計（CAD/BIM）、電腦圖學（Graphics）與深度學習（AI/MLOps），成為引領 Cooler Master 數位轉型的關鍵技術推手。 **【Key Responsibilities 】** 1. **數位孿生生態系建構：** 結合 NVIDIA Omniverse 與 Cooler Master 產品生態，開發從高真度 3D 視覺化到 AI 智慧決策的工業級數位孿生解決方案。 2. **USD 3D 資產 Pipeline 優化：** 將工業級 CAD/BIM 模型精準轉換為高效能 USD (Universal Scene Description) 格式，優化 RTX 渲染效能與物理真實感（PBR）。 3. **程序化與自動化工具開發：** 使用 Python/C++ 開發程序化建模（Procedural Generation）工具與 3D 資產自動佈置腳本，提升大型場景建構效率。 4. **合成資料（Synthetic Data）生成：** 設計並建構 3D 虛擬訓練環境，產生高品質的合成數據，驅動 Computer Vision 與 AI 模型的訓練與驗證。 5. **AI/LLM 與機器人模擬整合：** 研究並導入最新 NVIDIA SDKs，將 LLM Agent 與 Isaac Sim 整合至虛擬場景，實作智慧機器人與自動化流程之仿真部署。 6. **系統效能與品質導向：** 於「視覺真實度」與「實時執行效能」之間取得最佳平衡，建立技術規範與資產標準化流程。 **【 Basic Qualifications 】** * **工作經驗： 3** 年以上相關電腦視覺開發經驗，具備電腦圖學、物理模擬或 AI 工程原理基礎知識。 * **核心程式語言：** 精通 **Python** （Omniverse 核心開發語言），具備 **C++** 開發經驗者佳。 * **Omniverse 與 USD 架構：** 熟悉 NVIDIA Omniverse 平台生態系（USD Composer、Isaac Sim等）及 USD (Universal Scene Description) 架構。 * **3D 工具與渲染技術：** * 熟悉工業 CAD/BIM 軟體（如 SolidWorks、Revit） **或** 3D 創作軟體（如 Blender、Maya、3ds Max）。 * 理解 PBR 材質、光照、UV 展開及法線貼圖等視覺與圖學原理。 * **軟實力與語言：** 具備良好的技術 **中英文** 閱讀與溝通能力，能順暢閱讀國外原廠 API 文件，並具備跨團隊（客戶、美術專家、AI 研發團隊）溝通協調與問題解決能力。 **【 Preferred Qualifications 】** 1. 具備智慧工廠、工業自動化或智慧製造相關產業背景。具備相關專案落地經驗者優先錄取。 2. 熟悉工業模擬與工程分析工具（如 CAE、CFD、FEA 等）。 3. 具備 Computer Vision、PyTorch、MLOps 或深度學習專案實作經驗。 -- **【 About the Role 】** At Cooler Master, we are reimagining the future of hardware-software integration and smart manufacturing. As a Senior Digital Twin Engineer, you will stand at the forefront of NVIDIA Omniverse and Physical AI, seamlessly blending high-fidelity 3D visualization, LLM Agents, and robotics simulation (Isaac Sim). You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build an end-to-end industrial digital twin ecosystem—bridging physical reality and virtual simulation to power next-generation AI-driven decision systems. **【 Why Join Cooler Master? 】** * **Cutting-Edge Tech Stack:** Deeply leverage NVIDIA Omniverse, USD architecture, and Isaac Sim to shape next-generation smart factory simulations. * **Real-World Physical AI Impact:** Harness 2D/3D Synthetic Data generation and robotics simulation to overcome real-world data scarcity and deploy embodied AI solutions. * **Cross-Disciplinary Innovation:** Bridge industrial CAD/BIM engineering, computer graphics, and generative AI/MLOps into scalable, enterprise-grade applications. **【 Key Responsibilities 】** 1. **Digital Twin Ecosystem Architecture:** Integrate NVIDIA Omniverse with Cooler Master's product portfolio to deliver end-to-end industrial digital twin solutions—from 3D visualization to AI-driven decision engines. 2. **USD & 3D Pipeline Optimization:** Transform industrial CAD/BIM assets into optimized Universal Scene Description (USD) formats, ensuring maximum real-time physics fidelity and RTX photorealistic rendering. 3. **Procedural Generation & Automation:** Develop Python/C++ scripts and procedural generation engines to automate 3D scene creation and asset layouts. 4. **Synthetic Data Generation (SDG):** Design 3D simulation environments to generate high-quality synthetic datasets for training and validating Computer Vision and AI models. 5. **AI/LLM & Isaac Sim Integration:** Implement the latest NVIDIA SDKs to integrate LLM Agents and robotics simulation (Isaac Sim) into virtual environments for AI model deployment and validation. 6. **Performance & Quality Standards:** Drive resource assessment and technical trade-offs between rendering fidelity and system performance, establishing unified production guidelines. **【 Qualifications 】** * **Experience:** **3+** years of relevant computer vision engineering experience with a solid grasp of computer graphics, physical simulation, or foundational AI engineering principles. * **Programming Languages:** Proficient in **Python** (primary language for Omniverse); C++ experience is strongly preferred. * **3D & Omniverse Ecosystem:** Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Omniverse platform (USD Composer, Isaac Sim) and core USD (Universal Scene Description) framework. * **Software & Rendering Skills:** * Proficiency in CAD/BIM software (SolidWorks, Revit) **or** 3D DCC tools (Blender, Maya, 3ds Max). * Solid understanding of PBR texturing, lighting, UV unwrapping, and normal mapping principles. * **Soft Skills & Language:** Working knowledge of technical **Chinese/English** to read API documentation and technical specifications; strong problem-solving skills and cross-functional communication abilities (engaging with domain experts, artists, and AI R&D teams). **【 Preferred Qualifications 】** 1. Background in Smart Factory, Industrial Automation, or Advanced Manufacturing. Actual manufacturing site implementation experience is highly preferred. 2. Experience with engineering simulation tools (e.g., CAE, CFD, FEA). 3. Hands-on experience with computer vision, PyTorch, MLOps, or Deep Learning pipelines.
